itemList.description:
WORK TO BE UNDER TAKEN DURING MAINTENANCE-

Watering: The plants and lawns in the divider should be watered frequently as required looking to the climate, soil and plant conditions: If sprinklers are made available, it can be used other wise hose pipe can be used for watering, problems regarding pipe line damage during watering/maintenance should be repaired and taken care. Untill repair/maintenance contractor should make alternate arrangments (Water tanker)

Weeding: Weeding has to be done regularly in the entire divider area including extra weed growth in the pathways and other remaining areas in the park. Weeding should be done regularly once in a fortnight and the weeds collected should be used for preparing manure or it should be disposed from the divider appropriately

Maintenance of Shrubs, Edges, Ground cover and other area by regular pruning. digging so as to maintain the divider aesthetically.

Digging of soil around plants in the divider, should be carried out. Soil basins should be prepared around the hedges/ edges/trees/ shrubs/ ground covers by digging the soil so as to maintain retention of water. This should be done before and after monsoon.

Pruning of plants in the divider, such as the Hedges, Trees, Shrubs, Ground cover plants, Topiary plants, Rose plants etc., should be carried out as and when required and as per the directions of officer in-charge of work.

Transportation of plastic and other materials should be removed from the divider, must be taken care. The swept leaf materials only should be used for preparation of compost manure in the divider itself and the compost manure should be used in the divider. All dead plants, branches and other waste matirials should be removed regularly and transported outside the divider. in the divider area dried leaves and other waste materials should be regularly removed from the divider at the risk of contractors.

Unioformly spreading the compost and pesticides over divider bed as and when required and minor borewell repairs including safety of electrical control panel, a) Rashtrapati Circle to Ram mandir Circle b) Rashtrapati circle to Hirapur Circle c) S B Naka to Aland Check post e) Hagarga road divider f) SVP to Jagat Circle g) Bambo bazar to Humnabad ring road h) DC office to Aiwan-e-shahi i) Taj Sultanpur Circle to Jagadamba temple (Towards Bambo Bazar) j) PDA College towards Koranti Hanuman Temple k) Kusnoor road to sedam main road via Soubhagya Kalyan mantap 1) Ram Mandir towards PNT Quarters (For duration 1 months Rs. 23354.43) (For duration 3 months Rs. 70063.29)
